_readme: Origins allowed to call the API and read from S3.
Used in THREE places by lib/infra-cdk-stack.ts: API Gateway CORS,
the S3 bucket CORS rule, and the S3 bucket-policy aws:Referer condition.
Add a new temple's domains under 'temples'. Group names are free-form —
every array in this file is merged, so you can add new groups without
touching the stack code. Origins must NOT have a trailing slash.
Redeploy the CDK stack for changes to take effect.
